items.html: And in the fifth year, the Chesed of the Tzelem, which is in the middle article of the Netzach of Tevunah, enters into the Chokhma of ZA. And the third article of the Netzach of Tevunah, within which is the Netzach of the Tzelem, descends below into the Chesed of ZA. And in the sixth year, the Gevura of the Tzelem, which is within the middle article of the Hod of Tevunah, enters into the Bina of ZA. And the lower article of the Hod of Tevunah, within which is the Hod of the Tzelem, descends below into the Gevura of ZA. And in the seventh year, on the first day of the year, immediately the corona of the Yesod of Tevunah enters within the Daat of ZA — as is known that the corona of the Yesod of Tevunah is in the Daat of ZA, for it is known that the corona of the Yesod of the Nukva is "from my flesh I shall behold God," which is above, between the two middle articles of the NH of Tevunah, and slightly higher; therefore it enters after them, and not between the two lower articles, because the middle line is short, as is known.
